databases.name: SCS
databases.description: Asterion Devices synthetic supply-chain warehouse. Snowflake; serve path is Athena-federated (no direct-SQL driver for Snowflake).

tables.name: DIM_CURRENCY
tables.description: Currency reference with approximate USD exchange rates

tables.name: DIM_PORT
tables.description: Major ports and airports for logistics

tables.name: DIM_SUPPLIER
tables.description: Supplier master — 500 suppliers across commodities and countries

columns.name: IS_PROBLEM
columns.description: Flagged problem supplier for demo scenarios

columns.name: LEAD_TIME_DAYS
columns.description: Average lead time in calendar days

tables.name: DIM_PART
tables.description: Part master — 30,000 parts across all commodities

tables.name: BOM_HEADER
tables.description: Bill of Materials headers — one per product revision

tables.name: BOM_LINE
tables.description: BOM line items — components per assembly

tables.name: GOODS_RECEIPT
tables.description: Goods receipts — 90,000 receipts against PO lines

columns.name: DAYS_VARIANCE
columns.description: Days early (negative) or late (positive) vs promise date

tables.name: SHIPMENT_LINE
tables.description: Shipment line items linking to orders or POs

tables.name: IOT_SENSOR_READING
tables.description: IoT container sensor readings — 500,000 rows, ~1.5% breach rate

columns.name: BREACH_FLAG
columns.description: TRUE if any reading exceeds threshold

tables.name: FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT
tables.description: Inventory snapshots — ~1.2M rows (part x warehouse x month-end)
